items.headline: Tutor & Education Agent | Comprehensive Programmes for All Levels and Ages
items.about:
I’m the Founder of Kirsty’s Tuition, a personalised tutoring service providing high-quality one-to-one support and connecting families with a trusted team of expert tutors from Primary to A Level.

My mission: to use my 12+ years of experience in education to help learners build confidence, close knowledge gaps, and achieve meaningful academic progress through tailored, engaging teaching.

Having worked as a Teaching Assistant, Primary School Teacher, and full-time online tutor, I understand that every learner is different. That’s why I personally select and support each tutor in the Kirsty’s Tuition team, ensuring families receive professional, personalised support from experienced educators.

What Kirsty’s Tuition Provides:
• One-to-one tuition from Primary to A Level
• SATs, 11+, GCSE and A-Level support
• SEND-aware teaching and personalised learning plans
• English as a Foreign Language (EFL) tuition for children and adults
• Exam preparation, revision support and academic mentoring
• A carefully selected team of DBS-checked, experienced tutors

Much of our work begins with understanding each learner’s needs, strengths, and goals. From there, either I or a member of my team creates a tailored approach that helps students develop the knowledge, confidence, and skills they need to succeed.

Who We Work With
• Parents seeking expert support for their children
• Students looking to improve confidence and academic performance
• Adult learners developing their English communication skills
• Schools and organisations requiring targeted intervention and tuition

Why Families Choose Kirsty’s Tuition
• Experienced, carefully selected tutors with proven expertise
• A supportive, relationship-driven approach that builds confidence
• Clear communication and personalised learning plans
• High-quality teaching focused on long-term progress and success

Whether a learner needs to catch up, prepare for exams, or reach their full potential, we are passionate about providing the support and encouragement needed to help them thrive.

📍 Online tuition available worldwide.
🏡 Some face-to-face tuition available in selected areas.

⭐ See what parents say about their experience with us:
https://www.google.com/maps/place//data=!4m3!3m2!1s0x4ce5f144ea30aa5f:0xf04773a75c432092!12e1?source=g.page.m.dd._&laa=lu-desktop-reviews-dialog-review-solicitation

currentPosition.description:
I am the Founder of Kirsty’s Tuition, a personalised tutoring service supporting learners from Primary through to A Level, alongside English language learners worldwide.
 
With over 12 years of experience in education as a Teaching Assistant, Primary School Teacher, and online tutor, I specialise in delivering tailored, engaging tuition that builds confidence and drives measurable progress.
 
My team and I provide and coordinate high-quality support across:
 • Primary English & Maths (KS1–KS2)
 • SATs and 11+ preparation
 • GCSE and A-Level support
 • English as a Foreign Language (children, adults, and professionals)
 • SEND-aware, personalised learning plans
 
My small team are carefully selected, DBS-checked tutors, most of whom are heads of department with over 20 years of teaching experience, to ensure families receive expert, consistent, and high-quality support across subjects and age groups.
 
My approach is highly personalised, focusing on understanding each learner’s needs and goals before delivering structured, engaging lessons that improve both confidence and attainment.
 
I am passionate about making education accessible, effective, and supportive for every learner.

items.headline: Predictable growth for B2B companies via proven Content + GTM systems | Co-Founder & CEO, 4Socials, ROSAAVÉ & BotanicalKtown

parsed.text: New York City, NY, United States

items.about:
Hi, I'm Mustufa, founder of 3 businesses. The one you're here for is 4Socials, where 64 clients have gotten 2.1B views, 500K+ followers & $49M+ in revenue from the content & outbound systems we run for them.

My own content has done 150M+ views across social media. Garry Tan shared my article on LinkedIn. Naval Ravikant liked 4 of my posts on X & Elon Musk liked one.

1/ 4Socials is what made me who I am today.
We work with founders who have the same problem: they spend 1000s of dollars on paid ads & the leads never look like the buyers they want. We fix it with organic content on LinkedIn, X, Instagram & more.

The first 3 months:

1st month, TOFU: creating awareness about you
2nd month, MOFU: making you the obvious choice
3rd month, BOFU: prompting your audience to buy from you

Once your presence is strong, we move to our GAP Framework: growth (virality), authority (leads) & personal (acknowledgement), worked on every day instead of ONE per month.

You fill our questionnaire first & we tell you the success rate we predict for your offer before you pay us.

Our GTM service is for massive organizations & it's a numbers game on 3 channels.

Intro = Cold email
Reach out = Warm calling
Personalisation = Hot DMs

We email your ideal buyers, if they reply we call within 48 hours to book a call with you, then add them on your LinkedIn.

^ Nothing goes to waste & the follow-ups are timed using psychology so you get a reply without annoying the prospect.

2/ ROSAAVÉ, my wild child, is a luxury clothing brand making feminine outfits where, when girls wear them, they don't only look beautiful but they FEEL beautiful. It was created out of pure emotion, it's close to me & I design every outfit myself. We launched in May 2026 & in 3 months it had a cult following.

3/ Botanical Ktown was my first pitch, at my university's Ideapreneurship event in 2021, to see if I could do business. It made the Top 16 out of 300. It's about renewable resources & biodegradable products, paused till I can fund it the way I want to.

Next up: a 4Socials media department (movies & sitcoms, I'm good at making people laugh & cry) & more companies in AI, food, hospitality & the creative arts.

Oh, I bootstrapped both 4Socials & ROSAAVÉ. 4Socials started with a few hundred dollars in tools & no VC money, & I like it that way, nobody else gets a vote on what these companies become.

If you want these systems on your profile, book a discovery call by sending me a DM or via the following link:

https://calendly.com/4socials-growth-blueprint/30min

currentPosition.description:
Predictable growth for b2b companies.

We work with:

1. Investment Banks
2. Established Creators
3. Business Consultants
4. 7-9 Figure Ecom Brands
5. B2B Companies/Agencies

Our goal is to help you secure high-value, qualified leads.

We do this with content + outbound.

Let's start with content first, as who doesn't like inbound leads?

For social media content, specifically for LinkedIn and X, we use our system called the "GAP Framework".

GAP Framework translates into 3 types of content that gives you 3 types of outcomes.

G = Growth = Gets you attention
A = Authority = Brings you leads
P = Personal = People get to know you

When you combine these 3 types of content, your audience goes from strangers to potential buyers.

Result? People become curious and want to know more about how you can help them.

We've helped 58 clients since 2024. Together, they've gotten:

1. $49+ million in combined revenue
2. 500k+ combined followers
3. 2.1+ billion views

By January 2026, we will start to offer a multi-channel outbound system, which will change the course of your business, regardless of where it is right now.

Our outbound system works like this:

→ Find data through Apollo 
→ Enrich it with Clay 
→ Create hyper-personalized emails 
→ Send emails 
→ Warm calls 
→ Meeting scheduled via LinkedIn outreach

And now your leads are consistent and predictable.

Our systems are proven as we use them on ourselves to get clients.

Interested?

Book a call with our team (link in featured section)
